OFFER TO PURCHASE FOR CASH
Up to 250,000 Shares of Common Stock of
STELLARIS PRIVATE HOLDINGS INC.
at $31.00 Per Share in Cash

The Offer will expire at 5:00 p.m., New York City time, on October 28, 2026.

The Offer is being made only to qualified institutional buyers as defined in Rule 144A under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended.

Odd Lots. Eligible holders who own beneficially or of record fewer than 100 Shares and who tender all of those Shares will have their Shares accepted for purchase before proration of the Shares tendered by other eligible holders.
